segments.oily: Not enough reviewers identify as oily-skinned to characterize this segment.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin (including self-described "Sahara desert dry" and dry climates like Vegas or Florida) consistently report the serum relieves flakiness and stretchy/dry feelings and leaves skin hydrated and smooth, sometimes layered under a moisturizer for extra richness.
segments.combination: No reviewer explicitly identifies as combination skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one with rosacea, report calming, no stinging or redness and no breakouts, though this segment overlaps heavily with dry and acne-prone self-descriptions.
segments.normal: One reviewer with dry skin suggests those with normal skin may be able to use the serum alone without layering, but no reviewer self-identifies as normal skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing their skin as aging or mature (including women in their 50s) report smoother texture, more even tone, firmer feel and reduced appearance of fine lines.

concerns.aging: Reviewers addressing aging report firmer, plumper skin, more even tone and less noticeable lines after weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: This is the most repeated benefit: reviewers describe fast relief from dryness and flakiness, sustained hydration through the day, and no stretchy or tight feeling, including in dry climates.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with severe rosacea reports a marked reduction in redness and calming effect; another with slight cheek redness reports some improvement after two weeks; a sensitive-skin reviewer confirms no redness caused by the product.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer who already has a healthy skin barrier reports the serum helps skin "come together" and look its best, but no reviewer reports repairing a compromised barrier specifically.
concerns.spots: No reviewer discusses spots or hyperpigmentation directly.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts or irritation, and one reviewer's teenage daughter reportedly saw acne improve; no reviewer describes new blemishes from use.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer reports on oil control or shine reduction.
